subject: Short sponsorship request to keep sandbox live during procurement lag
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Gary Li <gary.li@novalign.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Short sponsorship request to keep sandbox live during procurement lag

Hi Gary,

Thanks again for the time last week — we really enjoyed seeing what NovAlign is building. I heard from finance on your side that the PO is still routing and may take another 5–7 business days to clear. I want to make sure your engineering team doesn’t lose momentum while that’s happening.

Would a short sponsorship (5 calendar days) of sandbox credits help keep your evaluation active? We can provide a limited voucher that: 
- Provides up to 50k tokens dedicated to your sandbox account
- Is limited to non-production datasets (we require no PHI or live patient data during the sponsored window)
- Expires automatically after 5 days

If that sounds useful I can get manager approval and issue the code today — we’ll attach a one-page addendum (SLA-addendum.pdf) outlining the limits so finance can see the guardrails. If you prefer a different token amount or a shorter window, tell me and we’ll adjust.

Quick ask: please confirm the sandbox project id your team uses (so we don’t accidentally apply credits to the wrong environment).

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: SLA-addendum.pdf
From: Gary Li <gary.li@novalign.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:02:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Short sponsorship request to keep sandbox live during procurement lag

Jonas — thanks for the quick follow-up and for offering this. A couple of clarifying questions before we accept: 

1) Does the voucher allow us to continue running the same model variant (v0.9-opt) we’ve been testing, including two concurrent workers?
2) Are logs and quota usage retained for our audit purposes after the voucher expires?
3) You mentioned non-production datasets — our team will only be running synthetic test sets, but want to confirm this is fine.

Also, our sandbox project id is: novalign-sbx-2027.

If you can confirm those items I’ll route a quick note to procurement that we accepted the temporary voucher so they don’t accelerate the PO on our end unnecessarily.

—Gary
Gary Li
Head of Engineering | NovAlign, Inc.
gary.li@novalign.com | (650) 555-0199

Gary / Jonas — looping in as requested. I reviewed the ask and authorized a 5-calendar-day voucher to keep novalign-sbx-2027 active while your PO clears. Details below and I’ve attached the voucher terms for legal/finance.

Voucher: RBW-5DAY-NOVA
- Token allowance: 50,000 tokens (applied to project novalign-sbx-2027 only)
- Model support: v0.9-opt and compatible variants; supports up to 2 concurrent workers (no reserved throughput guarantees)
- Retention: logs and usage metrics retained for 30 days after issuance; we will export a CSV snapshot for your records upon request
- Data policy: must not process PHI or live production data under the sponsored credit; synthetic/test data only
- Expiration: voucher activates immediately when redeemed and expires 5 calendar days after activation

Next steps: Jonas — I’ll issue the voucher in the console and paste a DocuSign-lite addendum link to the deal record for procurement transparency: https://redwood.ai/docusign/DA-47291. Gary — if you want a longer window, tell us now and I’ll escalate (we may need a purchase commitment).

Attachment: voucher_terms.txt

Camila Reyes
Sales Manager, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0267

Camila / Jonas — this is perfect, thank you. We’ll redeem RBW-5DAY-NOVA against novalign-sbx-2027 now and confirm when the sandbox shows the credit. Appreciate the retention clarification and the DocuSign link — I’ll have procurement flag that addendum so their review is faster.

One small ask: can you enable engineer-level read-only access for our contractor (elaine@novalign.com) for the duration of the voucher? She needs to confirm a couple of integration tests. If that’s an easy toggle we’ll take care of the rest.

Thanks again — this keeps our demo cadence intact and removes pressure on procurement to rush approvals.
